plan: self-service A9 Chat half (money-surfaces) and spec 6.5b (credits)

en: How do I buy more AI credits?

steps: The low-credit warning (inbox banner and Wallet) links to Wallet > Buy AI credits
Pick a pack: you see the credits and the price in EGP, then Yes, pay (single-use token bound to the pack and price)
Pay on the card page; the credits are added when the provider confirms the payment (the card provider's webhook, a system route), once per payment, never when you return to the page
Purchased credits stay with you and do not expire at the end of the month
edgeCases: Price: the dearest per-credit rate among the monthly packages, times the pack size (Ruling CREDIT-PACK-PRICE-1)
A double click or a replayed webhook is one order and one credit
If the price moved between preview and pay the order is refused and you preview again
A failed payment adds nothing; a lost webhook is repaired by the daily inquiry
A refund of the payment raises a P1 for a person: credits are not taken back automatically
Card checkout off or no card provider: the card says so
Owner only; staff see the warning but not the card
assistantNote: moves money; the merchant pays on the card page themselves
